"""Plain-text contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List, Tuple

from rosterkit.models import Student


def check_has_email(student: Student) -> None:
    """Raise when a student has no email to put on the sheet."""
    if not student.email:
        label = f"{student.display_name} (id {student.student_id})"
        raise ValueError(f"no email on file for {label}")


def sorted_roster(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[Student]:
    """Students in display-name order, refusing empty or email-less input."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise ValueError("no students to build a contact sheet from")
    for student in roster:
        check_has_email(student)
    return roster


def column_widths(roster: List[Student]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    """Widest display name and widest section label in the roster."""
    name_width = 0
    section_width = 0
    for student in roster:
        name_width = max(name_width, len(student.display_name))
        section_width = max(section_width, len(student.section))
    return name_width, section_width


def format_contact_row(student: Student, name_width: int, section_width: int) -> str:
    """One text row: name, section and email in fixed-width columns."""
    name = student.display_name
    section = student.section
    return f"{name:<{name_width}}  {section:<{section_width}}  {student.email}"


def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """One aligned text row per student, sorted by display name."""
    roster = sorted_roster(students)
    name_width, section_width = column_widths(roster)
    rows: List[str] = []
    for student in roster:
        rows.append(format_contact_row(student, name_width, section_width))
    return rows

after.tests/test_contacts.py:
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.models import Student


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_by_display_name(self):
        """Rows follow last-name order, with columns padded to fit."""
        roster = [
            Student("2", "Okafor", "Ada", "A", "ada@example.invalid"),
            Student("1", "Lindqvist", "Bo", "B", "bo@example.invalid")
        ]
        rows = contact_rows(roster)
        expected = [
            "Lindqvist, Bo  B  bo@example.invalid",
            "Okafor, Ada    A  ada@example.invalid"
        ]
        self.assertTrue(rows == expected)

    def test_emails_start_in_one_column(self):
        """Sections of different widths still line the emails up."""
        roster = [
            Student("1", "Lindqvist", "Bo", "A", "bo@example.invalid"),
            Student("2", "Okafor", "Ada", "Period 2", "ada@example.invalid")
        ]
        rows = contact_rows(roster)
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].index("bo@") == rows[1].index("ada@"))

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        """A student without an email stops the sheet and is named in the error."""
        roster = [Student("7", "Quillon", "Ines", "A", None)]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            contact_rows(roster)
        self.assertTrue("Quillon, Ines" in str(caught.exception))

    def test_blank_email_counts_as_missing(self):
        """An empty email string is treated the same as no email at all."""
        roster = [Student("7", "Quillon", "Ines", "A", "")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows(roster)

    def test_empty_roster_raises(self):
        """An empty list is an error rather than an empty sheet."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
